items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Cy Coleman’s “My City.” [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, it sounded darn good.

ctx.x: Yeah, why did I do that, and there’s always something that’s a little funny that you could have done better, and you kind of re-live the day that you did it. It throws you right back there.
I’m trying to think the other day, a few days ago, I said let’s put that in again, oh, Cy Coleman’s “My City.”
